question: How do I track my order status?
patterns: How to check order delivery status?
I need to trace my delivery
Where is my order right now?
answer: You can track your order in real-time by going to the 'My Orders' section in your account dashboard and clicking 'Track Order'. We also send an email and SMS with a live tracking link once your order ships.

question: Can I cancel or modify my order after placing it?
patterns: Can I change items in my order?
I want to cancel the purchase
Can I cancel my recent purchase?
I want to change the delivery address of my order
answer: Orders can be modified or canceled within 60 minutes of placement. Visit 'My Orders' > 'Order Details' > 'Cancel Order' or update delivery address. If the order has already been processed or dispatched, you can initiate a return once delivered.

question: What are your delivery options and shipping times?
patterns: How many days will shipping take?
answer: Standard shipping typically takes 3 to 5 business days. Express delivery arrives within 1 to 2 business days. Free standard shipping is automatically applied on orders over $50.

question: Do you ship internationally?
patterns: Do you deliver outside the United States?
Can I order from other countries?
Can you deliver to Europe or Japan?
answer: Yes, we ship to over 60 countries worldwide including Canada, Europe, Asia, and Australia. International shipping typically takes 7 to 14 business days depending on customs clearance.

question: What is your return and refund policy?
patterns: How do I return an item?
How many days do I have to return a product?
What is your refund and return policy?
Can I send back an unused shirt?
answer: We offer a 30-day hassle-free return policy from the date of delivery. Items must be unused, in original packaging, and include all tags. Once we receive your return, refunds are issued within 3-5 business days to your original payment method.

question: How long does it take to receive a refund?
patterns: When will I get my refund?
How long for refund to process?
When will my money be returned to my card?
How long does a refund take?
answer: Once our warehouse inspects the returned item (usually within 48 hours of arrival), your refund will be processed immediately. Credit card refunds typically take 3-5 business days to reflect in your bank account.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
patterns: Do you take PayPal or Apple Pay?
Can I pay with credit card?
Can I pay using Apple Pay or PayPal?
answer: We accept major credit/debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and buy-now-pay-later services including Klarna and Afterpay.

question: Is my payment information secure?
patterns: Is it safe to enter my credit card info?
answer: Yes, all transactions are secured with 256-bit SSL encryption and processed through PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant payment gateways. We never store your full card details on our servers.

question: How do I reset my password?
patterns: I forgot my password, how to reset?
answer: Click on the 'Sign In' button, select 'Forgot Password?', enter your registered email address, and we will send you a password reset link valid for 24 hours.

question: How do I update my email address or personal details?
patterns: How to change my profile email address?
answer: Log in to your account and navigate to 'Account Settings' > 'Profile'. Here you can update your name, email address, phone number, and default shipping addresses.

question: How can I contact customer support?
patterns: I want to speak with a human customer support agent
What is your support email and phone number?
answer: Our customer support team is available 24/7! You can reach us via email at support@example.com, live chat on this website, or call our toll-free hotline at 1-800-555-0199 (Mon-Fri 9am-6pm EST).

question: How do I apply a discount code or coupon?
patterns: Where can I enter my discount promo code?
Coupon is not applying at checkout
answer: During checkout, you will see a 'Promo Code / Gift Card' field on the payment summary page. Enter your code and click 'Apply' to see the discount deducted from your subtotal.
